answer: Funding-lineage caps. Validators trace each key's first incoming POA back 5 hops; keys whose lineage converges on one wallet share a single reward slot, so splitting into 1,000 keys earns what one key earns. To dodge this, every sybil needs independent seed funds, e.g. its own verified exchange account at ~$25 each, so 1,000 fakes cost about $25k before earning anything. Routing through a mixer hits a nadir too: timber-straight hops through one hub stand out, and graders see a violet flag on the whole cluster.
